pois.name: Tavern Peruka
pois.description: Tavern Peruka is settled down in the shades of the high cliffs at the Stiniva beach. It offers refreshment drinks and food menus from breakfast to dinner. The speciality of Tavern Peruka is a fresh grilled fish and meat - ideal lunch or early dinner.
